title.purpose: The config title in the bar and the first line of a notice.

body.purpose: Root size: filter text, notice copy, and button labels.

name.purpose: Link names, which wrap instead of truncating.

description.purpose: The short phrase under a link name.

control.purpose: Segment labels, stepping to 600 when selected.

label.purpose: Uppercase group names in header strips.

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Sticky bar with a home icon, a slash, the config title, the filter, and the settings control.
components.html: /Dashboard
components.css: .ds-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(max-content, 1fr) minmax(0, 420px) 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 8px 16px; padding: 10px var(--gutter, 16px); background: var(--bg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); } .ds-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-title-separator { font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-3); } .ds-bar .ds-icon-button { justify-self: end; } .ds-filter { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; padding-inline: 10px 2px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); color: var(--text-3); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-filter:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-filter input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: none; font: inherit; color: var(--text); caret-color: var(--accent); outline: none; } .ds-filter input::placeholder { color: var(--text-3); opacity: 1; } .ds-icon-button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 0; color: var(--text-2); cursor: pointer; transition: color 100ms ease-out, background-color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-icon-button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--hover); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-group { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-group-header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 14px; background: var(--strip); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-2); } .ds-group-header h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-group-count { font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-3); } .ds-cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr)); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; overflow: hidden; } .ds-cells > li { min-width: 0; box-shadow: 1px 0 0 var(--border), 0 1px 0 var(--border); } .ds-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--cell-gap, 12px); min-height: 44px; padding: var(--cell-padding, 9px 14px); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-cell:hover, .ds-cell:active { background: var(--hover); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-cell-icon { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; color: var(--text); } .ds-cell-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; } .ds-cell-name { font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-cell-description { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-2); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-monogram { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2); }

narrative.overview:
The familiar dashboard grid, played straight and sharpened. Links sit in a precise joined grid instead of floating rounded tiles, so the screen reads as one ruled sheet that can be scanned at a glance. Nothing competes with the links: the only chrome above the grid is a thin top bar holding the title, a filter field, and a settings control.

The world is monochrome and quiet by construction. A pure white or cool near-black ground, cool neutral ink, one typeface, zero radius, and low-alpha hairlines do all the structural work. Density is high and even, with every link given the same weight, because the visitor arrives knowing what they want. Color arrives from two places only: the logos themselves, and a single amber signal that marks where input is and what Enter will do.

This system rejects sidebars, stat cards, hero headers, and soft shadows. It is a dashboard and does not pretend otherwise; the craft is in the precision of the grid rather than in a concept layered over it.
keyCharacteristics: Joined cells that share hairlines, with no gaps inside a group
Neutral header strips with a small tracked uppercase group name and a tabular count
Zero radius on every surface and control
One amber accent, reserved for focus, top match, and selected settings
Light and dark themes defined as single paired tokens

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: In the interface, amber marks only where input is and what Enter will do: focus, caret, selection, top match, and selected setting. It never decorates and never signals hover.

rules.name: The Content Color Rule
rules.body: Hue beyond amber comes only from bookmark icons, including monochrome icons given their own configured color. Chrome stays neutral.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans carries every role. Hierarchy comes from weight and small size steps, never a second face.

rules.name: The Real Structure Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase names real structure only: a group or a set of controls it directly labels. It never sits as a decorative line above other text.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes while filtering uses tabular numerals, so counts do not jitter.

rules.name: The Joined Cell Rule
rules.body: Inside a group, cells touch and share hairlines. Only group panels are separated by a gap.

rules.name: The Everything Is Visible Rule
rules.body: All links are on the page at rest. The grid never paginates, collapses, or scrolls within a panel.

rules.name: The Hairline Elevation Rule
rules.body: No surface casts a shadow. If two layers need separating, use a tonal step or a hairline.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: Every surface and control the system draws has square corners. Bookmark logos are third-party artwork and keep their own silhouettes.

dos: define every new color as one `light-dark()` pair, and meet WCAG AA in both themes.
use zero radius and a 1px hairline on every new surface and control.
keep cells joined inside a group, with shared rules and no gaps.
reserve amber for focus, the top match, and selected settings.
use Lucide icons at stroke 1.75 with square caps and miter joins.
give a monogram fallback to anything that loads an external icon.
keep every control at 44px or more on coarse pointers.
match the existing 100ms ease-out for color and background transitions, and honor reduced motion.
donts: add a sidebar, stat cards, or a hero header.
round corners on anything the system draws.
add shadows to surfaces. `box-shadow` only draws 1px zero-blur rules and inset rings, and the logo halo is the only blur.
introduce a second typeface or a display or headline size.
use amber for hover, decoration, or emphasis in copy.
tint chrome with a second hue; logos are the only other color.
use tracked uppercase as a decorative line above other text.
